name: Mabel's Mettle
description: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Up to one other target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
couldNotDerive: That the second target must be different from the first (TargetUnique$True).
notes: Found and fixed a real gap: Pump had no TargetMax$/TargetMin$ qty handling at all (unlike ChangeZone/PutCounter's identical convention), so "up to one other target creature" read as a single mandatory target. Added qty:0..N support. Verified: node D now shows qty:0..1. TargetUnique$True ("OTHER target" -- must differ from the first Pump's target) remains unencoded -- deliberately not approximated with not:self, which means something different (excluded from being this card itself, not excluded from being a sibling target) and would have been a wrong fact, not just an imprecise one. Left open rather than guessed at.
